facts.fact: Le Mauricien reports that Mauritius Telecom launched its My.t Cloud services at its Rose-Belle data centre on 27 March 2024, for local and international businesses to outsource and store data, an investment of over Rs 1 billion.

Le Mauricien reports Mauritius Telecom's CEO and the minister describing the Rose-Belle data centre as Tier IV and to international standards at its opening on 27 March 2024; this is the operator's statement, no certifying body is named.
